reviews.text: Disputed a bill for the first time in over 20 years as a customer. Was left feeling unheard, no understanding, empathy or attempt to compromise. Was told i could always take my dogs elsewhere - so i did. Am delighted i did, wish i'd done it years ago.

As always seen at the exact time of appointment (8.45am 07.10.26) which is important as my cat hates the vets. Saw the same lady vet as last year - so lovely with the cat and extremely thourough in her annual examination. The annual jab was hardly felt at all. She is a credit to Neil and the team.

Lovely Vets, always helpful, the health plan means we don’t have to worry about sudden unexpected costs and now includes a certain number of consultations. Been taking my dog here for 6 year and he’s always well looked after,
Really friendly and efficient
Always helpful

Excellent vets.  Gram and Chom my bonded teenage boy cats were looked after by Beechwood after being rescued after their previous human died and really enjoy their return visits.  Also provided vet staff with entertainment and lots of fun!
Good experience, both cats cared for perfectly
A great friendly veterinary service at beechwood vets really great staff.

Excellent and capable vets but the charges over the last year or so have become extortionate.I was shocked today  to discover that the consultation fee alone is £66 before any meds or other treatment are taken into account.
A national enquiry has found that vets are indeed massively overcharging pet owners.They are greedy and extortionate and are jeopardising the lives of pets and making them suffer because many pet owners cab or afford these substantial fees.
SHAME!

This is directly from my cat Leo. He’s asleep so too busy to write reviews. He loves the staff at Beechwood vet on Chapeltown Road. He says: "They are very thorough and put my health and well being at the top of the agenda. I feel safe and looked after with them. I wouldn't let her take me anywhere else! She'd know about it if she did."
There you have it, from the cat’s mouth!
His human says: Leo was treated with excellent care and attention. The vet, AEL, answered all my questions and explained everything really clearly about his care. When he came home, he was relaxed and did not seem traumatised by the trip in the car or the visit to the surgery. He's very happy and therefore so am I!

Excellent, friendly and polite service was provided by the receptionist while I was waiting. The vet offered a quiet, minimal‑conversation service following a 30‑minute wait; however, the interaction and service remained professional throughout.
Really good service, advice & guidance with  pleasant & polite staff.
Used Beechwood for years, always been happy with the service provided.
First class veterinary clinic you can’t go wrong with BEECHWOOD GROUP
Super helpful care from the vet and everyone treated my kitten as a lil star 🌟 …
The vet, the nurse and the receptionist that we met today were all absolutely lovely.

Hi Neda,  
Thank you for the great review. We really appreciate it.  
All the best,  
Beechwood Veterinary Group
All of the vets and administrators are kind and helpful. They love animals ! My dog loves to come she’d be there everyday if she could !! Claire Walton and Betsy
Excellent caring service for our cat Cleo having her vaccination and other jabs without any fuss; she does not like being picked at all  normally.

Hi Ms Despina,  
Thank you for the great review. We really appreciate it.  
All the best,  
Beechwood Veterinary Group

I've used Beechwood vets for 17 years and they have always been caring and compassionate and not just for my cats. I became severely disabled 9 years ago and vet AEL always gets a chair for me. Pebbles, Poochi and Bella have always found it a not so scary visit and all the staff are incredibly kind and accomodating.

Excellent practice. The vet spent ages answering my questions on pet care and preventative measures.  You can tell that they really care about our pets.
The receptionists/nurses were also very friendly and polite and made us feel welcome.
Very happy with my choice of vets and I wouldn't take my pets any where else (my branch is the Chapel Allerton branch.
Thank you Beechwoods for always putting us at ease and making our visits as stress free as possible.
I have been going to Beechwood for 16 years and I always found the staff are very knowledgeable and helpful with all sorts of problems.

Wilson has just had his check up and vaccinations. He was very well looked after and made two more friends for life. The staff were excellent and the whole experience was fantastic.
Thank you both.
All of my cat's have been going to Beechwood Vet's for years & years, I'm happy with the service and the treatment my cat's get, and the staff are alway's friendly, thank you...
I recommend this Veterinary Practice as my pets have always been well cared for.

The lady on the reception was so rude and hostile. We were 5 minutes late because of unforseen traffic, appt was at 5:30 and we called in 5:32 informing we are stuck and will be there in 5 mins, she was not at all understanding and told us we should have I formed earlier. We had taken the day off from work and she asked us to come again next time which was not possible due to our jobs. Please consider this before going here!! Easy to say, not coming back and cancelling my plan with pet plan :(

Hi Linda,  
Thank you for the great review. We really appreciate it.  
All the best,  
Beechwood Veterinary Group
They take excellent care of my cat and always happy to see him; be it a nurse or vet, and are approachable, helpful and always available within surgery times. Would recommend.
First class service

We been going to Beechwood for 34 years with various cats and have been extremely happy with the service and support we have received. They have an excellent health plan which includes vaccinations,flea and worming treatments. The staff are efficient and friendly, could not recommend highly enough. My happy cats are healthy and content.
Recently joined. Really friendly and helpful
Lovely vets never been so greatful for the lady's on that day, my dog was chocking they responded  fast and made sure he was OK. Thank you amazing team x

Beechwood Vets at Chapeltown are amazing, they consistently provide a top class service.  I have used their services with one pet or another for twenty years or more and could not take my pets anywhere else. They make your pets really comfortable treating them like their own, my dog Saxon drags me into the vets for pets and cuddles ftom the staff when we visit, they take the time to calm my nervous cocker spaniel Poppy before treating her. If I could give more stars I would.
All the staff here are friendly  professional and knowledgeable. Both animal and humans are treated with kindness and sympathy.
The vet was very thorough and caring, and the vet nurse was kind and attentive as well.
I’ve been a client at this practice for over 30 years, and the majority of the time have been very happy with the team and service and care given under at some times difficult circumstances.

Hi Luke,  
Thank you for the great review. We really appreciate it.  
All the best,  
Beechwood Veterinary Group, Chapel Allerton

We have used this practice for many years and always been impressed by the wonderful service from both the vets and reception staff. We feel our beloved pets have been in safe hands at all times. For those we have sadly lost, this was handled with extreme sensitivity and compassion

Very pleased after my first visit to Beechwood Chapel Allerton. Lucy was so kind and understanding. She took time to listen and
to explain what she felt was happening with my cat Ziggy. I am very grateful for her advice and care

A small and friendly team who have always provided an excellent service. I have taken my dog here since he was a puppy and he's now 13. He loves the vet as we manage to see the same one on each visit, and this is good for owner and pet.
Great practice - the team are very friendly and compassionate and the care received by our pets is always top quality. Highly recommend.
Very friendly and professional,

We have been clients at Beechwood Chapel Allerton for over 30 years and have always been extremely happy with the service. They go above and beyond to make my cats comfortable atake excellent care of them.
Thank you Beechwood

I’ve always used Beechwood & can’t speak highly enough of them.
The vers & nurses are really knowledgeable & helpful & they genuinely care about your pet. …

Really appreciated the vet's approach - talking me through all the processes as part of my cat's check up. This was a new vet that I had not met before. My cat was surprisingly friendly and relaxed despite having a jab. …

Unfortunately we are not very impressed with the service we’ve received so far. It’s good when nothing happens and all you need is a worming pill or vaccination, but if there is a problem it’s not easy either to get an appointment, or to …

Hi Caerulean,  
Thank you for the great review. We really appreciate it.  
All the best,  
Beechwood Veterinary Group
